name: Micronesia
system_note: The president is chosen by Congress.
snapshot: A federation of four island states spread across the western Pacific, tied to the US by a renewed compact and courted by China.
culture: Each of the four states, Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei and Kosrae, has its own language and traditions. Yap is famous for rai, giant stone discs used as money and still exchanged in ceremonies. Pohnpei holds Nan Madol, a city of basalt islets built from the 12th century, often called the Venice of the Pacific.
society: The economy depends on US compact funding, fishing licences and subsistence farming. Many citizens have moved to Guam, Hawaii and the US mainland. Chuuk has held votes on independence from the federation. Climate change threatens low-lying atolls.
situation: Wesley Simina was chosen president by Congress in 2023. The Federated States of Micronesia renewed its Compact of Free Association with the US in 2024.
power: A federation of four island states. Congress elects the president from among its at-large senators, and the states hold much of the power.
